state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors report that on the QuALITY comprehension task, debate between two LLM experts, who possess the information needed to answer and each argue for a different answer, helps non-expert judges who lack this information, with non-expert models reaching 76% and humans 88% accuracy versus naive baselines of 48% and 60%. They further report that optimising expert debaters for persuasiveness in an unsupervised manner improves non-expert ability to identify the truth in debates, which they see as encouraging evidence for aligning models with debate in the absence of ground truth.
title: Debate helps non-expert LLM and human judges on QuALITY; persuasive debaters help more
